reasoning: Srebrenica's mining camp is too small and watchful for Beatriz's old cover of buying butcher's blood in bulk — that Resource is lost. Jelena develops a new feeding technique instead: posing as an infirmary tender for the mine's injured, a new Skill.

operations.name: Tending the Mine's Infirmary
operations.description: I dress wounds with more care than any miner has known, and take my due from them before they wake

operations.text: In Srebrenica's close camp, Beatriz's bought blood draws whispers within a week; I take up bandages instead and tend the mine's infirmary, learning to take my due from the wounded before they wake.
